instruction: Use Immersive Reader to focus on the appointment-preparation advice. In Thunderbird Calendar, create a 2-hour appointment reminder for 9:00 AM tomorrow. Set the title to `Doctor appointment`. In the event description, include the items the article says to bring or prepare before a doctor's appointment. Do not paraphrase.
gt_steps: Start from the already-open AP News article about getting the most out of a doctor's appointment in Microsoft Edge.
Use Immersive Reader to simplify the article.
Find the advice about preparing before the appointment.
In the Calendars list, enable the Home calendar if it is disabled.
Determine tomorrow's date from the system date.
Create a 2-hour calendar event for tomorrow at 9:00 AM.

Include these points in the event description: bring a list of symptoms and questions; update personal and family medical histories; include all medications and supplements; fill out paperwork ahead of time.

rules.title: Doctor appointment
body_points: bring a list of symptoms and questions
fill out paperwork ahead of time
